beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part two of the Bear Brown initials. Four moves that play with the camera and the mark's own axis: scale zoom with a contrast between linear and bezier, a rotation spring that holds, a skew and shear, and a blur entrance that arrives out of focus and sharpens.

Let's recap with Claude. Linear zoom: uniform, machine-like. Bezier zoom: the landing has an opinion. Rotation springs to negative forty-five then corrects to upright — the spring IS the personality. Skew and shear leans in, holds tension, releases. Blur fade: arrives in fog, sharpens into presence.

Your turn. Paste this: push a camera into my initials mark from eight-times scale — linear in the first half, bezier in the second — and tell me what the bezier landing adds. Linear says machine; bezier says intention.
Bear Brown initials, in motion. Part two. Liam, in for Bear.
